findings.highlight: I just wanted to double check.
findings.evidenceJa: ま、決まってるならハッキリしてていい。
findings.governingReading: He recalls forgotten stew decision and says if decided, that makes it clear.
findings.explanation: Remembering the decision becomes claiming he only wanted to double-check.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜のシチューっていったらホワイト
findings.governingReading: 桜のシチューっていったらホワイト identifies the stew she makes as white, motivating chicken purchase.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s characteristic stew becomes her preference for white stews.

findings.evidenceJa: いっぱい買ったねシロウ！
findings.governingReading: Illya’s bought-so-much dialogue ends before narration.
findings.explanation: Spoken line lacks closing quotation mark.

findings.highlight: Illya stops and turns to me.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは走るのを止めてピッタリとついて来た。
findings.governingReading: 走るのを止めてピッタリとついて来た has her cease running and follow right beside him, leading parallel walk16.
findings.explanation: Stopping running to stay close becomes stopping and turning to him.

findings.highlight: The tune is simple and gentle, yet lonely.
findings.evidenceJa: 素朴な曲は優しく簡単で、だからこそ淋しげだった。
findings.governingReading: だからこそ makes loneliness follow precisely from the gentle simplicity.
findings.explanation: Simple and gentle therefore lonely becomes simple and gentle yet lonely.

findings.evidenceJa: なんていうことはない。
findings.governingReading: なんていうことはない leads ordinary siblings image, repeated unremarkable adjective next.
findings.explanation: Nothing remarkable becomes nothing else to say.

findings.governingReading: 呼び止める describes calling Illya, who answers.
findings.explanation: Calling to stop her becomes holding his breath.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤはある事をずっと押し殺している。
findings.governingReading: ある事をずっと押し殺している means she has kept something suppressed since Archer disappeared; this concealment allows ordinary smiles.
findings.explanation: Constant suppression of a particular concern becomes occasional sullenness.

findings.highlight: take back the things you couldn't do until now
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで出来なかった分、これから取り返していく
findings.governingReading: 今まで出来なかった分、これから取り返していく asks to make up going forward for what was not possible before.
findings.explanation: Making up lost time becomes taking back things never done.

findings.highlight: even if we're only starting now?
findings.governingReading: 今のままでいい accepts the present relationship without replacement/family rearrangement.
findings.explanation: As we are now becomes only starting now.

findings.highlight: if one of us makes a sacrifice, the other might be able to live a little longer.
findings.evidenceJa: どっちかがどっちかを犠牲にすれば、少しは生きられるかもしれない
findings.governingReading: どっちかがどっちかを犠牲にすれば makes one sacrifice the other and possibly live; direction follows ordinary omitted subject of 生きられる.
findings.explanation: Surviving by sacrificing the other becomes the other surviving when one makes a sacrifice.

findings.highlight: how she can say it all with a smile.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな事を笑顔で口に出来る諦め
findings.governingReading: 諦め is the resigned attitude allowing her to say this with a smile.
findings.explanation: His failure to understand her resignation becomes failure to understand only her smiling manner.

findings.highlight: Projection magecraft, can supplement a Projection that resembles the original to a degree.
findings.evidenceJa: オリジナルに似せた物に“投影”を重ねて“補強”する事はできる。
findings.governingReading: Ordinary Projection can be layered onto an object resembling the original to reinforce it. Shirou instead must construct everything through his own mental image.
findings.explanation: An existing lookalike object reinforced through Projection becomes a Projection supplemented by more magecraft. This changes the method being contrasted with Shirou's complete mental construction.

findings.governingReading: Ordinary Projection is the subject and can supplement predicate.
findings.explanation: Comma divides subject from finite modal without an insertion.

findings.highlight: It'll take more than a fleeting fragment of his memories.
findings.evidenceJa: さっきみたいな一時的な記憶の欠損なんかじゃすまされない。
findings.governingReading: Using the arm will cause more than the temporary memory impairment Shirou experienced earlier.
findings.explanation: Temporary memory impairment becomes the loss of a fleeting memory fragment. This belongs with Shirou's threatened loss of self.
